Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly selected Peter Bjorn and John as the “performer of Falling Out,” asserting (wrongly) that their album was the earliest and proceeding to use the band’s origin (Stockholm) to pick Stockholm Palace. This disambiguation error ignored Serena Ryder’s 1999 album Falling Out and her birthplace (Toronto), which leads to the correct castle, Casa Loma. The mistake began when the Planner arbitrarily chose PB&J and misinterpreted “performer”/“birthplace,” leading the workflow down the wrong path.
